commands.name: Mimic.configureContext
commands.description: Configure an existing empty automation-framework-owned Context atomically before creating user Pages. Rejects live Pages, active capture and concurrent Page creation.
commands.notes: Atomically configures an existing empty framework-owned Context before Pages are created, preserving the real client Context object. Rejects live/initializing/closing Pages, retained uploads and capture workers; profile/proxy/resource/media validation failures leave the Context unchanged.

commands.name: Mimic.createContext
commands.description: Creates validated generated/imported environment contexts with optional canonical media configuration installed before creating Pages. Failed media configuration disposes the new Context. Existing profile token, proxy, resource policy and disposeOnDetach behavior are preserved.
commands.notes: Creates validated generated/imported environment contexts with optional canonical media configuration installed before creating Pages. Failed media configuration disposes the new Context. Existing profile token, proxy, resource policy and disposeOnDetach behavior are preserved.

commands.name: Mimic.setMediaProfile
commands.description: Atomic Context-owned catalog replacement; stable seeded auto selection, source/identity isolation and optional microphone grouping. Live or starting capture rejects replacement. CPU crop/scale, frame-rate reduction and optional coherent output noise; advanced native camera controls are unsupported.
commands.notes: Atomic Context-owned catalog replacement; stable seeded auto selection, source/identity isolation and optional microphone grouping. Live or starting capture rejects replacement.
